intent: A deep moss court gown with bone neck and waist trims, close sleeves and a wide tiered skirt falling to a lichen ruffled hem, reading from the high camera as a slim dark bodice over a great moss-and-lichen bell under a bone-fan bonnet.
requests: A tapered or cone part: a full skirt built from boxes can only step outward in tiers rather than fall as one smooth bell.
